game_concept: A arcade set in Eldritch Ruins – Crypt Stairs, stairs to a crypt: the ruin warden must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Queue Line: Serve a queue of visitors with pop(0) in first-come order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Crypt Stairs: stairs to a crypt
core_gameplay_loop: In Crypt Stairs, repeat each round: Serve a queue of visitors with pop(0) in first-come order. Each round, a new glyph tablets challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the queue_calm value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 220 points of glyph tablets by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 220, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 4 (applied tier): Queue Line
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Queue Line' (Week 7 slot 4), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Crypt Stairs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how queue_calm changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Crypt Stairs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 220 within 39 seconds.
